Thanks for your interest in this issue! However, there are already open PRs addressing issue #7927: #7931.

To avoid duplicate efforts, this PR has been closed. If you'd like to contribute, you can review the existing PRs or share your thoughts on [issue #7927](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/issues/7927).

If you believe the existing PRs are inactive, please comment on the issue and a maintainer can reassess.

#### Approvability

**Verdict:** Approved at `faa6954`

Macroscope's review found this PR approvable — This is a narrowly scoped bug fix that corrects binary-buffer rendering in LLMJudge prompts without changing unrelated inputs or public schemas. Focused tests cover bytes, bytearray, memoryview, and undecodable data, with no sensitive or deployment-related changes.
